problem:
Consider the matrix $K$ for which ${\lambda }_{1}=2$ and ${\lambda }_{2}=-5$ are eigenvalues, and

$$
{v}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,{v}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]
$$

are the respective eigenvectors. What are the values of $a,b,c$ given that

$$
K=[\begin{aligned}b & 1 \\ 0 & c\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 & 0 \\ 0 & a\end{aligned}]{[\begin{aligned}b & 1 \\ 0 & c\end{aligned}]}^{-1}?
$$
